title: Escaped trailing space in identifier is lost because the query is trimmed
property: a selector built as '#' + escapeCssIdentifier(id) matches the element with that id
expected: 1 element matched (an escaped space '\ ' is part of the identifier per CSS syntax)
actual: 0 elements: the trailing escaped space is stripped when the query is trimmed, so the id parsed is 'a' followed by a dangling escape
evidence: escapeCssIdentifier is documented to escape characters 'that would otherwise not be valid in a selector' (CSSOM serialize-an-identifier), so its output should be usable in a selector; it emits '\ ' for space, which select() then mishandles at the end of the query
